mapper.sql: id, username, password, real_name, email, address, role, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO APIGRAB_SYSTEM_USER (username, password, real_name, email, address, role, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{email}, #{address}, #{role}, #{status, typeHandler=com.gitee.apigrab.persistence.handler.EnableStatusTypeHandler})
mapper.update: UPDATE APIGRAB_SYSTEM_USER SET password = #{password} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM APIGRAB_SYSTEM_USER WHERE role = #{role} AND status = 1
